title: Automated screen capture censoring and layout presets for global quickstarts
creator: Lena Park
description:
Goal: Build a repeatable, automated pipeline that produces brand-consistent UI screenshots and quickstart visuals for docs and release notes across locales and product variants. The pipeline must: 1) safely redact or mask PII and customer-specific tokens from live screens, 2) perform device-aware smart crops and safe-zone framing for different aspect ratios, 3) apply brand tokens (colors, corner radius, device frames) from the design system, 4) swap localized text overlays and language-specific screenshots without exposing real customer data, 5) emit metadata for each asset (locale, route, component, crop presets) and integrate with the release assets registry.

Scope: - Capture orchestration service hooks (dev builds + staging + recording harness) - Redaction rules engine (regex+heuristics+visual blur for free-form text) - Smart crop presets and auto-layout templates (desktop/phone/tablet) - Localization pipeline: pairing screenshots with translated string snapshots and fallback rules - Post-process: device frames, watermarking for internal drafts, export sizes (1200x800, 800x600, 320x568) - QA checklist + automatic visual diffing and an ops dashboard for failures.

Acceptance criteria: - Pipeline produces reproducible screenshots for at least 5 core quickstart routes across en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP without leaking identifiable data. - Redaction false-positive rate under 3% on a 200-sample test set; false-negative rate < 0.5%. - Exported assets include a JSON metadata file with keys: route, locale, timestamp, cropPreset, redactionPolicy, designTokenVersion. - Assets land in the release-asset bucket and appear in the Console quickstart gallery within the release candidate build. - Figma design tokens are applied consistently; visual QA signoff from Design and Docs required.

Non-goals: - Full OCR-based translation pipeline is out-of-scope for this ticket. - On-device screenshot capture for customer-managed Private deployments will be handled in a follow-up.

Implementation notes: - Reuse existing capture hooks from ENG/screenshot-harness; add a lightweight middleware to sanitize request payloads before capture. - Redaction engine will combine: schema-based field masking (emails, IPs, keys), regexes for common token formats, and an optional adaptive blurring model for free text. - Cropping will use content-aware seam-finding for UI to preserve CTA visibility; fallback to predefined presets when confidence is low. - Localization preview mode: overlay translated strings from the latest l10n snapshot in Confluence; fallback to pseudo-locales for missing translations. - Provide a CLI to trigger batch runs and a web UI for curated approvals.
